commands.label: Open…
commands.description: Load a mechanism from a file.

commands.label: Save
commands.description: Write the mechanism to its file.

commands.label: Save as…
commands.description: Write the mechanism to a new file.

commands.label: Export cut file
commands.description: Open the cut-file panel — DXF or SVG of the selected bodies, or of all of them.

commands.label: Auto-backup
commands.description: Open the auto-backup settings: timestamped copies written to a folder.

commands.label: Delete everything
commands.description: Empty the document — inside a component, only that definition.

commands.label: Shortcuts…
commands.description: Open the keyboard-shortcut panel: import, export or reset the keymap.

commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Take back the last change.

commands.label: Redo
commands.description: Put back the change that was taken back.

commands.label: Copy
commands.description: Copy the selected body or selection.

commands.label: Paste
commands.description: Paste the copied bodies at the cursor.

commands.label: Group / ungroup
commands.description: Group the selected bodies — or dissolve the group that is selected.

commands.label: Delete
commands.description: Delete the selection, or the selected measurement (either mode).

commands.label: Cancel
commands.description: Step back out: close a panel, drop an armed constraint, disarm the tool, leave a group or component.

commands.label: Finish
commands.description: Close the shape being drawn, or accept a pattern's count.

commands.label: More corner radius
commands.description: Round the selected body's corners one step further (a disk grows).

commands.label: Less corner radius
commands.description: Take a step of rounding off the selected body's corners (a disk shrinks).

commands.label: Draw / Simulate
commands.description: Switch between building the mechanism and running it.

commands.label: Run / pause animation
commands.description: Start or stop the actuators and motors.

commands.label: Auto-pause
commands.description: Pause the animation as soon as the assembly becomes impossible.

commands.label: Body role
commands.description: Every shape drawn from now on becomes a rigid body.

commands.label: Cut role
commands.description: Every shape is subtracted from the body under it — a hole inside, a notch across the outline.

commands.label: Reference role
commands.description: Every shape becomes construction geometry: snappable and measurable, never simulated or exported.

commands.label: Polyline (body)
commands.description: Draw a free shape corner by corner, in the Body role.

commands.label: Polyline (cut)
commands.description: Draw a free shape corner by corner, in the Cut role.

commands.label: Rectangle
commands.description: Two opposite corners — Shift for a square, Alt to draw from the centre.

commands.label: Circle
commands.description: Centre, then the rim: a disk, a round hole or a reference circle.

commands.label: Regular polygon
commands.description: Centre, then a corner; the side count shows beside the cursor.

commands.label: Slot
commands.description: Both ends, then the width — a capsule.

commands.label: Line
commands.description: A reference segment between two points.

commands.label: Arc
commands.description: A reference arc: its two ends, then a point it passes through.

commands.label: Text
commands.description: A label; clicked on a body it rides with that body.

commands.label: More sides
commands.description: One more side on the armed polygon tool, or on the selected regular polygon.

commands.label: Fewer sides
commands.description: One side fewer on the armed polygon tool, or on the selected regular polygon.

commands.label: Linear pattern
commands.description: Repeat a hole or a joint along one or two directions.

commands.label: Circular pattern
commands.description: Repeat a hole or a joint around a centre.

commands.label: Split
commands.description: Cut a body in two along a path drawn across it.

commands.label: Combine
commands.description: Merge the selected bodies into one — they must overlap or share an edge.

commands.label: Subtract
commands.description: Cut the other selected bodies out of the first-selected one.

commands.label: Intersect
commands.description: Keep only the overlap of the selected bodies.

commands.label: Joint
commands.description: Add a joint point to a body, where two bodies overlap, or free in space.

commands.label: Weld
commands.description: Lock overlapping bodies rigidly together at a point, or toggle a pin weld ↔ revolute.

commands.label: Connect
commands.description: Pin two joints together, or attach a joint to a rail as a rider.

commands.label: Ground
commands.description: Fix a joint's position, or a whole body; click again to release it.

commands.label: Rail
commands.description: Draw a track for pin-in-slot riders between two joints.

commands.label: Slider
commands.description: Make a body slide along an arrow without rotating.

commands.label: Linear actuator
commands.description: Make a slider or rail self-driving: its carriage travels back and forth in animation.

commands.label: Motor
commands.description: Spin a crank pin about a pivot on the same body.

commands.label: Mirror left↔right
commands.description: Flip the selection horizontally.

commands.label: Mirror top↔bottom
commands.description: Flip the selection vertically.

commands.label: Send to back
commands.description: Put the selection behind everything else.

commands.label: Bring to front
commands.description: Put the selection in front of everything else.

commands.label: Rotate
commands.description: Drag a body to turn it about its centroid, or a node to turn it about that node.

commands.label: Create component
commands.description: Pack the selection into a reusable definition — or fork the selected instance.

commands.label: Component browser
commands.description: Insert, edit, rename or delete component definitions.

commands.label: Auto constraints
commands.description: Arm alignment constraints by holding a drag over a corner, joint or edge.

commands.label: Coincident
commands.description: Make two points share a position, or hold a point on a line.

commands.label: Equal
commands.description: Give two lines the same length, or two circles / rounded corners the same radius.

commands.label: Horizontal
commands.description: Hold a line — or two points — horizontal.

commands.label: Vertical
commands.description: Hold a line — or two points — vertical.

commands.label: Parallel
commands.description: Hold two lines parallel.

commands.label: Perpendicular
commands.description: Hold two lines at a right angle.

commands.label: Tangential
commands.description: Hold a line tangent to a circle or arc.

commands.label: Symmetrical
commands.description: Make two points, or two lines, mirror images across a third line.

commands.label: Fixed
commands.description: Lock a point where it is, or lock a line's angle and position.

commands.label: Constraint badges
commands.description: Show or hide every constraint badge.

commands.label: Show the grid
commands.description: Show or hide the grid.

commands.label: Grid size
commands.description: Open the grid-spacing list.

commands.label: Grid line style
commands.description: Open the grid line-style list: solid, dashed, dotted or points.

commands.label: Measure
commands.description: Dimension a line, or the distance between two references — in either mode.

commands.label: Show measurements
commands.description: Show or hide every measurement.

commands.label: Snap to grid
commands.description: Snap placement and dragging to the grid.

commands.label: Object snap
commands.description: Snap onto corners, edges, midpoints and centres of other objects.

commands.label: Fit to screen
commands.description: Frame the whole mechanism.

commands.label: Rotate the view
commands.description: Open or close the dial that turns the whole picture.

commands.label: View upright
commands.description: Turn the view back to 0° (while the dial is open).

commands.label: Zoom in
commands.description: Zoom in about the middle of the canvas.

commands.label: Zoom out
commands.description: Zoom out about the middle of the canvas.

commands.label: Light / dark theme
commands.description: Switch between the light and dark themes.

commands.label: Help drawer
commands.description: Open or close the manual beside the canvas; while it is open, clicking a control explains it.

commands.label: Manual contents
commands.description: Open the manual at its table of contents.
